category_title: Students with high online continuity and regular LMS engagement
minimal_context: The student is participating in a face-to-face communicative practice activity about weekend plans.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For our face-to-face practice today, please discuss your plans for the weekend with your partner.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: My plan for the weekend is to listen to my favorite type of music.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you discuss about your plans?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will ask my partner. Do you share the same preferences? Yes, me too.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to have a deeper conversation about why you like that music.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have the words to generate a rich discussion. I managed my online assignments and posted my few lines, but right now I can only use the language to display basic sentences like 'I like this music'.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: For our face-to-face practice today, please discuss your plans for the weekend with your partner.

STUDENT: My plan for the weekend is to listen to my favorite type of music.

TUTOR: What else can you discuss about your plans?

STUDENT: I will ask my partner. Do you share the same preferences? Yes, me too.

TUTOR: Try to have a deeper conversation about why you like that music.

STUDENT: I don't have the words to generate a rich discussion. I managed my online assignments and posted my few lines, but right now I can only use the language to display basic sentences like 'I like this music'.
